legend: Vector Willman and Array Bolt are the two most famous athletes of Byteforces. They are going to compete in a race with a distance of L meters today.
Willman and Bolt have exactly the same speed, so when they compete the result is always a tie. That is a problem for the organizers because they want a winner.

While watching previous races the organizers have noticed that Willman can perform only steps of length equal to w meters, and Bolt can perform only steps of length equal to b meters. Organizers decided to slightly change the rules of the race. Now, at the end of the racetrack there will be an abyss, and the winner will be declared the athlete, who manages to run farther from the starting point of the the racetrack (which is not the subject to change by any of the athletes).

Note that none of the athletes can run infinitely far, as they both will at some moment of time face the point, such that only one step further will cause them to fall in the abyss. In other words, the athlete will not fall into the abyss if the total length of all his steps will be less or equal to the chosen distance L.

Since the organizers are very fair, the are going to set the length of the racetrack as an integer chosen randomly and uniformly in range from 1 to t (both are included). What is the probability that Willman and Bolt tie again today?
input: The first line of the input contains three integers t, w and b (1 ≤ t, w, b ≤ 5·1018) — the maximum possible length of the racetrack, the length of Willman's steps and the length of Bolt's steps respectively.
output: Print the answer to the problem as an irreducible fraction ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cb0172a656698061aefa8eb30b2dbcd1e31f508e.png). Follow the format of the samples output.

The fraction ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cb0172a656698061aefa8eb30b2dbcd1e31f508e.png) (p and q are integers, and both p ≥ 0 and q > 0 holds) is called irreducible, if there is no such integer d > 1, that both p and q are divisible by d.
note: In the first sample Willman and Bolt will tie in case 1, 6 or 7 are chosen as the length of the racetrack.

legend.ai: Vector Willman 和 Array Bolt 是 Byteforces 最著名的两位运动员。他们今天将参加一场距离为 L 米的赛跑。
Willman 和 Bolt 的速度完全相同，因此他们比赛时结果总是平局。这给组织者带来了问题，因为他们希望决出一名获胜者。
在观看之前的比赛时，组织者注意到，Willman 只能迈出长度为 w 米的步子，而 Bolt 只能迈出长度为 b 米的步子。组织者决定稍微改变比赛规则。现在，跑道尽头将会有一个深渊，能够从跑道起点跑得更远的运动员将获胜（跑道起点不会被任何运动员改变）。
注意，两名运动员都不可能无限远地奔跑，因为在某个时刻，他们都会到达这样一个位置：只要再向前迈出一步，就会掉入深渊。换句话说，当运动员所有步子的总长度小于或等于所选距离 L 时，他不会掉入深渊。
由于组织者非常公平，他们将把跑道长度设为一个从 1 到 t（包括 1 和 t）中随机均匀选取的整数。求今天 Willman 和 Bolt 再次平局的概率。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，当赛道长度选为 1、6 或 7 时，Willman 和 Bolt 将打成平手。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含三个整数 t、w 和 b（1 ≤ t，w，b ≤ 5·10^18），分别表示跑道长度的最大可能值、Willman 的步长以及 Bolt 的步长。

output.ai: 请将答案以不可约分数 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cb0172a656698061aefa8eb30b2dbcd1e31f508e.png) 的形式输出。请遵循输出样例的格式。
如果不存在整数 d>1，使得 p 和 q 都能被 d 整除，则称分数 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cb0172a656698061aefa8eb30b2dbcd1e31f508e.png)(p 和 q 为整数，且满足 p ≥ 0、q > 0)为不可约分数。
